Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking an experienced Back-End Developer to join the Digital Operations team and build innovative digital solutions that support Vodafone's transformation into a Digital Telco company.
You will develop high-quality Back-End applications, services, APIs and reusable components using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript and JavaScript (ES6+) , with a focus on microservices and enterprise system integration. Working within a multidisciplinary team of Data Engineers, Software Developers and System Specialists, you will contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and technical design through development, testing, integration and production deployment.
This opportunity is suited to candidates with at least 5 years of professional Back-End development experience , ideally within complex enterprise environments, and hands-on experience with scalable, reliable and secure digital solutions.
 What You’ll Do
Develop and maintain high-quality Back-End digital solutions, services and reusable components supporting web and mobile applications 
Build modern Back-End solutions using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript and JavaScript (ES6+) 
Design, develop and maintain microservices, REST APIs, web services and system integrations 
Enable reliable and secure data exchange between applications, services and internal or external enterprise platforms 
Improve the performance, reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of digital products 
Participate in requirements analysis, technical design and solution definition for new business requirements and product enhancements 
Apply appropriate testing, code reviews, engineering standards and development best practices to maintain high code quality 
Contribute to Back-End development and system integration standards, coding guidelines and engineering best practices 
Work within Agile delivery frameworks, contributing to planning, refinement, development and delivery activities 
Apply CI/CD and automation practices across development, integration, testing and deployment 
Troubleshoot application and integration issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions 
Evaluate emerging Back-End technologies, integration approaches, frameworks and architectural patterns for their potential application within the digital ecosystem 
Share technical knowledge and good practices with colleagues to support team development 
Deliver high-quality software products and associated documentation 
Produce reports associated with software testing and defect resolution 
 Who You Are
A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience 
At least 5 years of professional experience in Back-End development, preferably within complex enterprise environments and large-scale digital solutions 
Proven hands-on experience with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript and JavaScript (ES6+) 
Experience designing, developing and maintaining microservices-based applications 
Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, API design and system integration patterns within distributed architectures 
Experience integrating heterogeneous applications, services and enterprise platforms 
Good understanding of containerisation and orchestration principles in cloud-based environments 
Experience developing and delivering Back-End services in cloud-based environments 
Understanding of Cyber Security and secure software development, including authentication, authorisation, API security, secure data handling and data protection 
Experience with Git-based version control, package management, build processes and code-quality tooling 
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, testing and deployment 
Experience with unit, integration and API testing 
Experience across the software development lifecycle, from requirements and technical design to deployment and ongoing product evolution 
Experience working in Agile environments, preferably Scrum and/or SAFe 
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to identify root causes and define effective technical solutions 
An ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional and multicultural teams and communicate with technical and business stakeholders 
A commitment to software quality, security, maintainability, attention to detail and continuous improvement 
Fluent written and spoken English at C1 level 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working: 2 days from office per week (8 per month)
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the following options: meal tickets / private pension / vacation vouchers / cultural vouchers - within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills 
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun, and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
Scalable Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript Back-End development 
Microservices and distributed application architecture 
Enterprise API and system integration design 
Secure API development and data exchange patterns 
Cloud-based Back-End services, containerisation and orchestration 
CI/CD, automated testing and continuous delivery 
Application troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and service reliability 
Cross-functional Agile delivery and collaboration across technical disciplines 
Evaluating emerging Back-End technologies and applying relevant approaches to a digital ecosystem

 Join Us
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
